scope.e2_exclusion_reason: compatibility trajectory collected outside the preregistered E2 population

gate_order: predicted G10 first (pure geometry), then G3/G6, then G4, then G5. All gates are required, so a candidate failing one is rejected whatever the others would have said.
claim_boundary: Selects a route for collection. Admits no data, drives nothing, and makes no physical-hardware or contact-fidelity claim.
f_twin_1: OPEN -- no contact-physics claim rests on this pass

window.derivation: max_path_m (40.0, frozen in CollectConfig) + footprint_radius (0.24, frozen in M3PRO)
window.guarantee: Euclidean displacement cannot exceed path length, so every point of any route no longer than max_path_m from a start inside this window lies inside it. The window cannot exclude a route the frozen contract would admit from such a start.

sweep_resolution.derivation: smallest detectable unsupported/blocking feature = one occupancy cell (CollectConfig.grid_resolution); Nyquist gives probe spacing = cell/2; the route step equals the probe spacing; the yaw step is the rotation that moves the footprint rim by one probe spacing. Frozen before any production route was evaluated.
